# Prerequisite-ordered topics by unit

Full pack. Topic names/IDs come only from installed graph nodes. Source-derived levels remain level-unknown where unsupported. Within-unit topic order follows the checked DAG; unresolved cross-unit conflicts are disclosed in meta_rules_and_index.md.

Evidence: g = exact graph node ID; c = observed course count; src = existing graph source key; SDP/CBSE identify the downloaded source line. T/A point to exact 1-based inclusive lines of the unchanged original unified_cloud_curriculum.md, resolved by the sibling teaching map. They are not guarantees of complete teaching/assessment scope.
